sessions.label: Recreate Agent Academy Recruit Course for New Copilot Studio UI
sessions.originalRequest: I would like you to recreate the whole Agent Academy Course for the new ui and put it in my repo

todos.title: Create Module 03: Declarative Agent for M365 Copilot
Create Module 06: Build a Custom Agent
Create Module 07: Add a Topic with Triggers
Create Module 08: Enhance with Adaptive Cards
Create Module 09: Automate with Agent Flows
Create Module 13: Securing Your Recruit Badge
Update facilitator guide with all modules

directives.directive: Structure: Create workshop/modules/ with numbered folders (00-course-setup/, 01-introduction-to-agents/, etc.), each with README.md
Content: Adapt original microsoft/agent-academy content with UI updates based on research notes
Screenshots: Use descriptive placeholders like [SCREENSHOT: Overview page showing Instructions section] with references to screenshot-audit-checklist
Preserve the connected scenario: All modules build ONE agent (Contoso Helpdesk Agent) using Contoso IT SharePoint site

delegations.task: Create all 14 course modules (00-13) adapted for new Copilot Studio UI
delegations.result: All 14 modules successfully created in workshop/modules/ with updated UI content, screenshot placeholders, and workshop-ready format. Connected scenario preserved throughout. Total: ~8 hours of hands-on content.

delegations.task: Complete facilitator guide with notes for modules 06-13 and create master course index
delegations.result: Facilitator guide updated with detailed notes for modules 06-13 including timing, common pitfalls, and troubleshooting. Master course index (workshop/README.md) created with full navigation, prerequisites, learning path, and delivery formats.

notes: The course consists of 14 modules (00-13) covering the full Agent Academy Recruit curriculum
Key UI changes: Overview page is now the main authoring surface, new Workflows experience, updated navigation
User has already completed research and created supplementary materials for modules 02 and 09
All modules created by Technical Writer - workshop-ready with screenshot placeholders
Total course duration: ~8 hours of hands-on content
Connected scenario preserved: All modules build ONE agent (Contoso Helpdesk Agent)

lessonsLearned.summary: Screenshot placeholders with clear descriptions enable asynchronous screenshot capture
lessonsLearned.detail: Using detailed descriptions like [SCREENSHOT: Overview page with Publish button highlighted] allows the screenshot team to work independently without constant back-and-forth clarification.

lessonsLearned.summary: Copilot Studio UI is still stabilizing with frequent navigation changes
lessonsLearned.detail: The new Overview page model launched in late 2025 but continues to evolve. Documentation should include version timestamps (e.g., 'Last updated: June 2026') to track freshness.
